chunks: 'Ali ibn Ibrahim, from Muhammad ibn 'Isa, from Yunus, from Ibn Muskan, from Mu'alla ibn Khunays, from Abu 'Abdullah (عليه السلام), who said:
The Messenger of Allah (صلى الله عليه وآله) said:

Allah, Blessed and Most High, Said: 'If there does not happen to be in the earth except for one Momin, I would have Sufficed with him from the entirety of My creatures, and would have Made for him, from his iman, a comfort such that he would not be needy of anyone.'

key_terms.أُنْسًا: comfort/companionship — intimate solace and ease from loneliness, bestowed upon the Momin through his iman
key_terms.إِيمَانِهِ: his iman — faith as an inner endowment divinely appointed to function as the believer's comfort and companion
key_terms.تَبَارَكَ وَتَعَالَى: Blessed and Most High — a divine honorific affirming Allah's transcendence, absolute goodness, and exaltation above all
key_terms.خَلْقِي: My creatures — the entirety of Allah's created beings, from whom He declares independence through even one Momin
key_terms.لَا يَحْتَاجُ: he would not be needy — the self-sufficiency granted to the Momin through his iman, making him independent of all of creation
key_terms.لَاسْتَغْنَيْتُ: I would have sufficed — expressing Allah's absolute self-sufficiency (ghinā), such that one Momin would be enough among all creation
key_terms.مُؤْمِنٌ: Momin — a true believer; one possessing complete and sincere iman in Allah

ai.seo_question: What does Allah say about the sufficiency of a single true believer (Momin) and the comfort of iman?
ai.summary: This hadith qudsi, transmitted through Imam Abu 'Abdullah (عليه السلام) from the Prophet (صلى الله عليه وآله), conveys a divine declaration of Allah's absolute self-sufficiency alongside His profound regard for the true believer. Allah declares that even a single Momin would suffice Him among all of creation, and that iman itself would be bestowed upon that believer as intimate comfort and companionship, rendering him independent of all others. The hadith elevates the station of the Momin and affirms that iman is a divine gift of incomparable worth.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from Muhammad Bin Isa, from Yunus, from Ibn Muskan, from Moalla Bin Khunays, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Allahazwj Blessed and High Said: “If there does not happen to be in the earth except for one Momin, Iazwj would have Sufficed with him from the entirety of Myazwj creatures, and would have Made his Emān to be a comfort for him, he would not be needy to anyone (else)’.
en.sarwar: 2. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from Muhammad ibn ‘Isa from Yunus from ibn Muskan from Mu’alla ibn Khanis from abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) who has said the following: “
The Messenger of Allah has said, ‘

Allah, the Most Blessed, the Most High, has said, “Had there not been more than one believer on earth, he would have been sufficient for Me in place of all of My other creatures and I would have made his belief to provide him good company to help him live independent of all creatures.’”
